design.first_action: forced both sides for each pair, held fixed across feedback variants
design.natural_first: exact replay slice matching the native first motor draw, from the same forced-side pair
design.second_action: native stochastic action before second feedback, with a shared draw across branches
design.truth: both private contact outcomes scored after the rollout; feedback stream is the only sign input
design.yoked: independent donor sign held fixed across both private truth signs
design.novel: new antipodal odor pair with |cosine| <= .75; score uses an arbitrary balanced reference slot
design.reset_h: zero recurrent activation after first receipt processing, before the neutral delay
design.receipt_matched_disabled: disable physical writes and replay natural receipt features for the same selection
design.random: sampled comparators replay the realized forced action for an independent held-out index; mean comparators average forced actions
design.oracle: uses forced-branch expected correctness to select the best of both proposals and skip; diagnostic upper bound
